name: M eighty-three Co. Ltd.
summary: M eighty-three Co. Ltd., founded on February 20, 2020, by Chul-Hwang Jung, Min-Soo Park, Kyung-Soo Baek, and Jun-Hyung Kim, specializes in the creation of diverse film and video content. Operating from its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea, the company provides production services primarily for feature films and television dramas, leveraging sophisticated computer graphics and visual effects (CG/VFX) technology to deliver compelling media.
